subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 11/11] mountd: don't warn about pipefs submounts nobody asked to export

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to stop issuing warnings when it encounters a submount that is not explicitly exported by an administrator. The change ensures that only paths that are being actively exported receive warnings, rather than all cross-mounts, which can lead to excessive and unactionable warnings.
